findings.summary: Steps with no declared parameters dump the whole carried-forward S4 args as unknown and drop their fixed constants; IQ and P14 misrepresented; 'fixed' never occurs.
Realised RUV outcome (applied, k, percentage, n controls) not in the record; ruv_k = null labelled user_set.
Provenance vocabulary drifted from the schema; validator does not constrain it; no legend.
FASTA identified by hash only; no database name, release, date, entries, taxonomy.
No upstream search provenance (DIA-NN version, library, settings) and no data_availability block.
The DIA-NN report prints version fields as NA; the record's software block is not overlaid.
SI written in kit vocabulary; descriptions carried but not printed; no parameter labels.
Report template prints fixed interpretive conclusions not derived from data.
Numerical environment (BLAS, threads, OS, locale) and the build identity absent from the record.
Replay proven same build/host, Linux, post-import, DA publication deferred, no enrichment; claim must be bounded accordingly.
No inst/CITATION; no per-kernel method citations; no scientific-package subset.
Design recorded in full but in internal shape, not SDRF.
No published JSON Schema for the record format.
Bundle only after Generate Report; Excel cell cap documented.
No series-level criterion reviewed the rendered record end to end; replay completeness and document completeness diverged.
What holds: byte-stable record, 918 values round-trip, 97 parameters rendered, no truncation, live UniProt header, honest claim limits.

closeout.claim_scope: DIA on-disk path, same build and host, from the DIA-NN report onward; the record is complete for replay but not yet complete or readable as a publication supplement.
